title: 9tz.1: tantivy dep + SearchConfig in config
description:
What: Add tantivy = "0.22" to crates/reader/Cargo.toml and add SearchConfig to crates/reader/src/config.rs.

Algorithm:
1. In crates/reader/Cargo.toml add under [dependencies]: tantivy = "0.22"
2. In crates/reader/src/config.rs add:
   #[derive(Deserialize, Default, Clone, Debug)]
   pub struct SearchConfig {
       pub index_dir: Option<String>,       // None = search disabled
       pub max_index_bytes: u64,            // default 10_737_418_240 (10 GiB)
       pub body_index_max_bytes: usize,     // default 102_400 (100 KiB)
       pub max_query_len: usize,            // default 4096
   }
   impl Default for SearchConfig { fn default() -> Self { Self { index_dir: None, max_index_bytes: 10_737_418_240, body_index_max_bytes: 102_400, max_query_len: 4096 } } }
3. Add 'pub search: SearchConfig,' field to Config struct in config.rs.
4. Add #[serde(default)] to the field.

Defensive rules: No unwrap(). SearchConfig::default() leaves search disabled (index_dir = None) — operators must explicitly opt in.

Tests: Add unit test 'search_config_defaults_to_disabled' verifying SearchConfig::default().index_dir.is_none().
